html:
SMTO-SYS-0006 — Stop unconfirmed

GUID: f1403a23-5cbc-4b1f-99fd-b3c9387ea518
Slug: stop-confirmation-unconfirmed
Domain: SYS · Subsystem: runtime

What happened

  • You stopped the task, but SMTO couldn't confirm that work it started in the background actually ended. The task stays stopped, and saved results are still available.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and make sure the Gateway that ran the work is connected. Reconnect it if it isn't. SMTO asks that Gateway whether the work ended, and it can't get an answer while the Gateway is offline.
  2. In the task's activity, find the Stop unconfirmed notice and select Check again. This runs one new round of checks; it doesn't restart the task.
  3. If the checks still can't confirm it, ask the person who manages that computer to look for the program still running and stop it there. Losing contact or waiting longer doesn't prove the work stopped, so someone has to look on that computer.

What success looks like

  • The Stop unconfirmed notice disappears from the task's activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the Gateway computer. Don't assume the background work has stopped, and don't start the same work again until it's confirmed.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Stop was requested, but the confirmation checks (up to 5 within 30 seconds) ended without exact evidence that the background work exited; the run stays cancelled and its job and resource claims are kept.

What this means

  • The bounded confirmation episode ended without exact terminal evidence. Missing records, an unreachable Gateway and elapsed time do not prove process exit. The run stays cancelled while unresolved jobs and resource claims are retained.

Why this can happen

  • The bounded confirmation episode ended without exact terminal evidence. Missing records, an unreachable Gateway and elapsed time do not prove process exit. The run stays cancelled while unresolved jobs and resource claims are retained.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the retained episode deadline and inspection count with the matching job identity. Only a terminal receipt with ended liveness and settled ownership establishes cleanup.

How to fix it

  • No direct repair is available for this occurrence. Use the supported investigation or alternative workflow below.
  • stop_confirmation ran its bounded probes without terminal evidence, so the run stays cancelled with job and resource claims retained. Reconnect the authenticated Gateway, then select Check again (the activity reconcile endpoint) to request one more bounded inspection episode; it does not resume the agent. Do not release claims or mark the process ended without matching terminal evidence.

Retry and execution caution

  • Reconnect the authenticated Gateway or select Check again to request one bounded inspection episode. This does not resume the agent.

How to verify the fix

  • Matching evidence confirms the connection or process state.

What not to do

  • Do not release claims or report a process ended without matching terminal evidence.

Technical notes

  • Do not release claims or report a process ended without matching terminal evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
